beliefs: The box strips trailing whitespace (including Unicode whitespace like NBSP and em-space) and then uppercases only the first character, keeping the rest unchanged [E1, E2, E3, E5]
Leading whitespace is preserved, so '  hello' stays '  hello' and ' hello world ' stays ' hello world ' [E2]
Trailing whitespace is stripped, so 'hello  ' becomes 'Hello', 'x   ' becomes 'X', and 'hello\u00a0' becomes 'Hello' [E2, E5]
A lone space or all-space string becomes empty, consistent with trailing-strip leaving nothing [E1, E2]
A tab or newline at position 0 is not uppercased and is preserved, so '\thello' stays '\thello' [E2, E3]
Digits, symbols, and already-uppercase letters are unchanged [E1, E4]
Uppercasing uses single-character .upper() semantics, not full case mapping: 'ß'→'Ss' and 'ǆ'→'ǅ' (only the first char is uppercased, and it takes just the first char of its uppercase expansion) [E5]
Only the first character is uppercased; the rest of the string is left untouched, so 'ÉCOLE'→'École' and 'straße'→'Straße' [E5]
